UserAccount.title: UserAccount
UserAccount.description: Publicly non-sensitive root account anchor for a Maloxie user. Holds no PII.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the account owner.

displayName.description: User display name shown in greeting and account header.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the account document was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the account document was last updated.

UserPrivateInfo.title: UserPrivateInfo
UserPrivateInfo.description: Isolated private PII record for a Maloxie user (Split Collection strategy).

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the account owner.

photoURL.description: Profile avatar URL from the OAuth provider.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when private info was last updated.

Habit.title: Habit
Habit.description: A tracked daily habit belonging to an authenticated user.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the habit owner.

frozenToday.description: Whether a freeze token is active for today.

completedToday.description: Whether the habit has been completed today.

history.description: 7-element boolean array representing the last 7 days.

notes.description: Bounded list of daily log strings (max 50 entries, <= 280 chars each).

tags.description: Bounded list of custom tag strings (max 15 entries, <= 24 chars each).

lastActiveDate.description: Local calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) for automatic daily rollover.

reminderTime.description: Optional daily local reminder time in 24h HH:mm format, or empty string when disabled.

color.description: Hex accent color for the habit card.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the habit was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the habit was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Root user account document anchoring ownership without exposing PII.

/users/{userId}/habits/{habitId}.description: User-scoped habits subcollection synchronized in real time.
